svg.title: 大钟寺AI产业集聚区 / Dazhongsi AI Industry Cluster - B - 存量与小商户 / Existing fabric and small business
svg.desc: Civic Continuity Protocol; Decision-ready. Implementation-gated. Dazhongsi AI Industry Cluster serves as the Open Urban Gateway. Option B, Existing fabric and small business. Provisional concept grid, not an official boundary. Public value is read first. Conditional study sequence: N · No preselected node (ALT-DZS-N) -> B · Existing fabric and small business (ALT-DZS-B) -> A · Station-industry interface (ALT-DZS-A); study lead: ALT-DZS-B. Project loop LOOP-PROJECT-EVIDENCE-DECISION: REVISE returns to evidence and STOP returns to N while retaining evidence; production loop LOOP-PRODUCTION-GENERATE-VERIFY: validation failure returns to revision and sealing waits for every seal condition. Public value: Use reversible adaptation and shared services to reduce new build and business interruption. Footprint: Six reversible stock cells; parcel IDs U Flow: Continuity loop; independent cell exits Beneficiary: existing small businesses and occupants exposed to renewal disruption Burdens: unknown ownership and building safety · tenant, rent and compensation burdens Exit: No irreversible works before formal approval; restore original operating processes when services withdraw. Gate: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL · BLK-X3-USER-BURDEN · BLK-X5-COST-EXIT · BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION Unknowns: Exact parcel, entrance, alignment, ownership, control and deployment geometry · Observed accessibility, demand, benefit, burden, dissent and distributional effect · Named authority, staffing, cost, procurement, exit performance and independent validation The OSM context is an exact path extract from a byte-closed R005 SVG; the option overlay is not spatially registered. The graphic scale uses concept units CU, not metres. Applicable gate IDs: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL, BLK-X3-USER-BURDEN, BLK-X5-COST-EXIT, BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION. Claims: I-ALT-DZS-B, U-SPATIAL-LOCATION, U-REAL-USE, U-IMPLEMENTATION. Sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-R005-METRICS, SRC-R005-OSM-DZS, SRC-R005-GEOMETRY, SRC-R005-ARCHIVE. Bid claims: I-CIVIC-CONTINUITY-PROTOCOL, I-BRIEF-ALIGNMENT-001, I-CONDITIONAL-PATH-001, I-DECISION-REQUEST-001, I-PROGRAMME-100D-001, I-DELIVERY-CONTROLS-001, I-SELF-LOOP-001, U-BID-ADMIN-INPUT-001. Bid sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-OFFICIAL-BRIEF-FACTS-20260509. 城市连续服务协议；可决策，待实施门槛。大钟寺AI产业集聚区承担开放城市门厅角色。方案 B，存量与小商户。暂定概念网格，非官方边界。公共价值优先核对。 条件性研究序列：N · 不预选节点 (ALT-DZS-N) -> B · 存量与小商户 (ALT-DZS-B) -> A · 站城产业接口 (ALT-DZS-A)；研究优选：ALT-DZS-B。 项目闭环 LOOP-PROJECT-EVIDENCE-DECISION：REVISE 回取证，STOP 回 N 并保留证据；生成闭环 LOOP-PRODUCTION-GENERATE-VERIFY：验证失败即回改，全部封印条件满足才封印。 公共价值: 以可逆改造与共享服务降低新建和经营中断。 空间足迹: 六个可逆存量单元；地块 ID U 流线: 连续运营环；单元可独立退出 受益者: 面临更新中断的既有小商户与使用者 负担: 权属与建筑安全未知 · 租户、租金与补偿负担 退出: 正式批准前不做不可逆工程；服务撤回后恢复原经营流程。 门槛: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL · BLK-X3-USER-BURDEN · BLK-X5-COST-EXIT · BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION 未知: 精确地块、入口、线位、权属、管控与部署几何 · 实测无障碍、需求、利益、负担、异议与分配效应 · 具名权责、人力、成本、采购、退出表现与独立验证 图中 OSM 背景为 R005 字节闭合 SVG 的精确路径提取；方案 overlay 未做空间配准。图形比例尺使用概念单位 CU，不是米制。 Applicable gate IDs: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL, BLK-X3-USER-BURDEN, BLK-X5-COST-EXIT, BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION. Claims: I-ALT-DZS-B, U-SPATIAL-LOCATION, U-REAL-USE, U-IMPLEMENTATION. Sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-R005-METRICS, SRC-R005-OSM-DZS, SRC-R005-GEOMETRY, SRC-R005-ARCHIVE. Bid claims: I-CIVIC-CONTINUITY-PROTOCOL, I-BRIEF-ALIGNMENT-001, I-CONDITIONAL-PATH-001, I-DECISION-REQUEST-001, I-PROGRAMME-100D-001, I-DELIVERY-CONTROLS-001, I-SELF-LOOP-001, U-BID-ADMIN-INPUT-001. Bid sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-OFFICIAL-BRIEF-FACTS-20260509.
